description: This source file defines a worker class named SyncWorker responsible for performing background synchronization tasks related to notes. It uses Android's WorkManager and Kotlin coroutines to execute the sync operation asynchronously, checking user preferences for whether background sync is enabled, and then invoking the note repository's sync function.

classes.name: SyncWorker
classes.description: An Android Worker subclass that performs background synchronization of notes, respecting user preferences and executing asynchronously using coroutines.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the CoroutineWorker's doWork method to perform the synchronization process, checking user preferences, calling the repository's sync method, and returning success or failure accordingly.
